input_fields.name: target_object_requirements
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `object_type`, `meaning`, and `required_properties` for one target object.

input_fields.name: geometry_properties
input_fields.description: Array of property objects, each with required keys `name`, `value`, `unit`, and `source_ref`; properties must be measurable.

input_fields.name: selection_tolerance
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `criteria`, `value`, `unit`, and `comparison` for approximate matching.

input_fields.name: topology_refresh_prerequisite
input_fields.description: Optional MS-07 output with required keys `action_id`, `affected_references`, `refresh_before_next_selection`, and `refresh_scope`; it is consumed, not synthesized.

result_fields.name: semantic_predicate
result_fields.description: Object with required keys `object_type`, `criteria`, `match_rule`, and `refresh_prerequisite`; nullable when the common output envelope records missing selection evidence.

result_fields.name: ambiguity_policy
result_fields.description: Object with required keys `zero_matches`, `one_match`, and `multiple_matches`, each stating the declarative handling policy.

procedure: Translate the target meaning into measurable criteria using only the supplied object type and geometry properties.
Attach units, tolerances, and comparison operators to each criterion and define the zero-match and multiple-match policy.
If an MS-07 topology-refresh prerequisite is supplied, carry its reference into `refresh_prerequisite`; do not create a refresh declaration here.
Return `semantic_predicate` and `ambiguity_policy` as action data; the predicate describes selection but does not execute selection or retain object handles.
rejection_rules: Reject recorded FaceN, BodyN, index, or Boolean-return order as a reusable semantic criterion.
Reject an unmeasurable requirement, missing tolerance for an approximate comparison, or an object type that is not determined.
Reject an absent or malformed MS-07 prerequisite when topology refresh is required; do not synthesize one inside MS-06.
Do not execute selection, return a selected object, or claim uniqueness when zero or multiple candidates remain.
